import "io" for FileFlags

System.print(FileFlags.readOnly)  // expect: 1
System.print(FileFlags.writeOnly) // expect: 2
System.print(FileFlags.readWrite) // expect: 4
System.print(FileFlags.sync)      // expect: 8
System.print(FileFlags.create)    // expect: 16
System.print(FileFlags.truncate)  // expect: 32
System.print(FileFlags.exclusive) // expect: 64
